title: Edit-time standards are reachable: labelled records carry the path or stack keys of the files they govern
body:
Evidence: #1385 (ec36b6d): node evals/retrieval/run.ts edit moment recalls 12/12 reachable but only 12 of 33 labels are reachable; the report names why each other label is unreachable (record has no stack/path key, its scope misses the case files, or the case names no file).
Outcome: every labelled record that applies at edit time carries a path or stack key matching the files it governs; edit recall of all labels is at least 0.75 and each remaining unreachable label has a written reason in evals/retrieval/cases.json.
Proof: node evals/retrieval/run.ts: edit of all 33 >= 0.75
Files: .agents/records.json, evals/retrieval/cases.json
